text:
Omar N: Hi all  Omar joining Platform today! Quick checklist Qs: how do I get API keys for staging, who issues VPN tokens, and where do people usually book a 1:1 with their manager? Also here's a fun icebreaker: two truths and a lie  I've climbed Kilimanjaro, I make sourdough, I can juggle three flaming torches. Guess which is the lie?

Jill S: welcome Omar! :wave: For staging API keys, open a ticket to infra-team with subject 'staging API key - <team>' and include your GitHub handle. VPN tokens are via Okta SSO; you should get an invite email from security-ops. If not, ping #eng-security and tag @Ravi P.

Ravi P: pinged. If the Okta invite doesn't land, I can manually trigger it. Also, 1:1s are booked on the team calendar (calendar.redwood.ai/team/platform). Your manager usually sets a recurring weekly 30-min slot in the first week.

devex-bot: Hi Omar  Your onboarding checklist has been created: https://onboard.redwood.ai/2105554321. Remaining: request laptop image, accept Okta invite, request staging API key. Reply "staging done" or "okta done" to update status.

Omar N: Thanks! Quick follow-up on API keys: do we have a machine-readable policy for key rotation or expiry? Trying to script renewals.

Marta L: We rotate staging keys every 90 days by default. See the policy here: https://handbook.redwood.ai/security/api-key-rotation. For automation we use the small CLI helper in git.redwood.ai/tools/key-manager (it's a tiny Go tool).

Jill S: also Omar  for local dev you might want the devcontainer we standardize on: https://git.redwood.ai/platform/devcontainer.json. It has a helper script to mount SSH agent and set up kubeconfig.

Omar N: perfect. And the lie is... the flaming torches  (I can't actually juggle fire). Glad to be here  excited to join the lunch/demos tomorrow. Any must-know Slack channels?

Ravi P: lol welcome aboard :smile: Must-knows: #platform, #deploys, #morning-coffee, #oncall-ops (if you're on rotation later). We also have #book-club which is surprisingly active.

Marta L: I left a small sticker pack and a welcome card on the new-hire shelf in the office. If remote, order via the swag portal and choose "new-hire bundle".

Omar N: Awesome, I got added to GitHub and queued the staging key ticket. Will reply "okta done" once SSO is up. Thanks everyone for the quick help!
